title: Operator-credentialed auth path for login-only targets (closes the #328/#329 emergent-registration-only gap)
goal: auth_discoverer.acquire_session() currently does EMERGENT registration only — it creates a new user via the discovered register form, then attaches the resulting session to the http client. Real-world live targets (DVWA, customer staging, internal corporate apps) frequently have NO registration flow; they only expose login with pre-existing credentials. acquire_session correctly returns None on those, but the entire universal-auth pipeline (the 5 migrated probes from #328, all downstream cross-target tasks) silently no-ops. This task adds a second strategy — operator-supplied credentials — wired through the existing acquire_session contract, so the same probes work on login-only targets.
scope: Extend `api/app/services/auth_discoverer.py` with `acquire_session_with_credentials(base_url, *, username, password, scope_allowlist=None, ...)` that re-uses fingerprint_application + build_recipe but POSTs to the LOGIN form (not register) with operator-provided credentials. Credentials are pulled from the existing `run_credential_vault` keyed by (run_id, target_id). Update acquire_session() to: (1) check if credentials are present in the vault for the target, (2) if yes, prefer the login path, (3) if no, fall back to the existing emergent-registration path. Per [[no-prescriptive-recipes]] no app-specific seeds; the LOGIN recipe is built by Claude Haiku from the fingerprint exactly like the REGISTER recipe is. Per [[feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes]] credentials are operator-supplied not seeded.
generation_reason: Identified during the 10-task deferred-capability audit. Never filed. Operator pushback 2026-05-17: 'Allemaal drie heb ik gezegd constraint says no, out of scope en doorgelopen. Geen follow-up gefiled.' This is the structural gap: most real targets are login-only — without this, the whole Phase 2 universal-auth pipeline is sandbox-only.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: New strategy + vault integration only. Do NOT change fingerprint_application, build_recipe, or the existing emergent-registration code path. Do NOT add a new fingerprint shape. Do NOT touch the 5 migrated probes — they consume acquire_session unchanged.
constraints.no_prescriptive_recipes: LOGIN recipe synthesized by Claude Haiku per [[feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes]] — no Gruyere/DVWA/juice-shop specific login flows seeded. Operator-supplied credentials are PER-RUN inputs, not app-specific seeds.
constraints.credential_handling: Credentials NEVER appear in graph entities (captured_value, observation attributes) per [[feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes]] and existing #334 redaction policy. Full values stay in run_credential_vault. Recipe execution carries them only as in-memory POST body fields.
constraints.scope_isolation: Per-engagement only — credential lookup is keyed by (run_id, target_id), inherits memory_backend isolation.

success_criteria: acquire_session() with credentials present in vault uses the LOGIN strategy (build_recipe synthesizes a login recipe from the fingerprint, executes it with operator credentials, verifies session cookie present).
acquire_session() with no credentials available falls back to the existing emergent-registration strategy (no behavior change for sandbox targets).
Live test on DVWA-style target (login-only, admin/password): probes complete with attempts > 0 (they currently no-op with auth_unavailable).
No credential leakage: assert that the operator-provided password value never appears in the returned session dict's logged/serializable fields, never in graph entities, never in DONE_LOG entries.

Unit tests cover: vault hit → login path chosen; vault miss → register path chosen; login fails → returns None with reason auth_failed (distinct from register's auth_unavailable); credential redaction in any log/exception bubble-up.
must_not_touch: 5 migrated probe runners (#328 contract — they consume acquire_session unchanged)

acceptance_criteria: Login-only targets that fail today (auth_unavailable) succeed when operator credentials are present in the vault.
Existing sandbox targets (Gruyere mock fixtures, juice-shop, testfire) continue to pass via the emergent-registration fallback.
Zero credential leakage proven by greppable assertion in tests.
